name: US Pharmaceutical Factory Shipments
citation: U.S. Census Bureau via FRED: A25BVS (Factory Shipments), MRTSSM44611USS (Retail Pharmacy Sales), A25BTI (Factory Inventory).
description: Monthly macro-level U.S. pharmaceutical supply chain series (1992–present). Concurrent retail pharmacy sales and factory inventory are covariates for factory shipments (no lag features).
preprocessing: 1. Source: FRED series A25BVS, MRTSSM44611USS, A25BTI merged on timesteps.
2. Dropped Month_Index and Inventory_to_Shipment_Ratio from task variates.
4. Timestamps as ISO-8601 UTC strings shared across variates.
5. Output CSV schema: variable_name, variable_unit, timestamps, values (3 variates).
